mappings.assertion: TestRuntimeInputGateSpendsBeforeLaunchAndRefusesReuse asserts the refused reuse's anomaly Details["code"] equals the plain string "runtime_input_consumed" and every requireRuntimeInputRefusal check keeps the "runtime_input_consumed:w03" spelling; TestK7VocabularySpelling pins all four runtimeInputCode spellings and TestK7VocabularyTypesCarryNoMethods proves the type carries no marshalling hook.

TestK7BlockerQuestionBoundary (3 questions accepted, 4 refused with "maximum 3 questions allowed per blocking protocol"), TestK7HypothesisExhaustionBoundary (0 and 1 failed_by do not block, 2 and 3 do), TestK7LimitEscalationAttemptBoundary (attempt MaxTaskAttempt-1 opens a new attempt, MaxTaskAttempt blocks), TestK7VocabularyNumericValues (every named size, limit and bound keeps its value) and TestK7VocabularySpelling (every typed vocabulary, lock label, actor, operation name, alert category and git mode keeps its literal spelling). TestK7TransitionSentinelPrefixGuardsClaims (a "$transitioning" sentinel is refused by the shared "$" prefix guard), TestK7RuntimeOwnerLabelSeparatesLedgerFromTasks (the ledger owner marker is kept apart from task IDs) and TestK7ProjectScopedLockNameIsDotlessAndSuffixed (project and agent-lifecycle lock names keep their byte form).

TestK7AssessmentFingerprintDigestsUnchanged pins the assessment fingerprint digests (all six outcome classes and the pending, failed and satisfied awaited states) and TestK7StateLockHoldMaterialDigestsUnchanged pins the state-lock-hold material digests (system_not_running and the unblock_ family), captured from the tree before the vocabulary types replaced the string spellings; the existing fingerprint, receipt and state-lock-hold tests run unchanged.

TestOracleAdmitHeldSlot (refused-held-slot: a waiter with --max-wait 0 is refused with exit 1 while a holder blocks on its FIFO; wait-then-run: the waiter queues, is observed through its queue ticket, and runs after the holder is released; no sleep decides either outcome) compares output against goldens committed in 1cb16b8aa before any admission edit; regen -mode check reproduces them and every older a3/control golden.

The live A3 oracle suites (TestOracleModeChange, TestOracleResumePaths, TestOracleAdmitHeldSlot and the earlier a3/control drivers) run against the typed vocabulary with no older golden, fixture or driver edited.

go test -race ./internal/ops/ ./internal/agent/ runs the TestClaimBreaker* suite (including the []ops.ReviewClaimClass loop) and the strategy_reviewer and claiming tests over the typed ReviewClaimClass, and in internal/ops the admission-slot, work-admission and state-lock-hold suites (admission_slot_test.go, blocked_episode_phase_hold_test.go) plus k7_digest_test.go and k7_vocabulary_test.go over the named lock labels and typed hold reasons.
make test runs the K7 vocabulary and digest tests, the ops and agent suites and every area's live oracles together.
